rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 D.E.I. DIVIDE ET IMPERA 2 Game Flow 2.1 The Action Phases 3 Standard Actions 4 Specialized Actions and Units 5 Additional Market Card Special actions: 6 Missions D.E.I. DIVIDE ET IMPERA In this game, you lead one of four factions in the ruins of London. Your Scavengers explore the map to collect Technology and Energy . These resources can be used to buy Market Cards or exchanged for Supplies (Victory Points/VP). Your goal is to have the most Supplies after four rounds. Game Flow The game lasts 4 rounds , each consisting of 3 Action Phases . Priority (Turn Order): In the first round, priority is random. In later rounds, the player with the lowest score gets the highest priority. Phases: Players take turns completing Phase 1, then Phase 2, and finally Phase 3. The Action Phases In each phase, you must perform two steps: Play 2 Action Cards: You can play them face up to perform all listed actions, or face down to use the Buy action (limited to one face-down card per phase). Phase-Specific Ending: Phase 1 (Round 1 only): Place your Leader and a set number of Scavengers in neutral shelters based on your priority. Phase 2: You may Learn Masteries (skills) if you control enough Outpost tokens of the same color. Phase 3: You must Complete a Mission . Standard Actions Recruit: Bring one Scavenger from your pool into an owned or neutral Shelter . Move: Move your Leader or Scavengers to an adjacent region. Majority Rule: You can only move into a region if you have (or will gain) the Majority there. Levels: Ground and Roof regions are only adjacent if connected by your own or a neutral Lift . Two Roofs are adjacent if connected by a Bridge . Collect: Take one resource from your region. This usually requires having the Majority . You can hold a maximum of 10 resources. Buy: Play an action card face down to purchase a card from the Market. Build: Place a Shelter , Lift , or Bridge in a region where you have at least one unit (Majority is not required). Specialized Actions and Units Enhanced Actions: Some cards allow you to Copy previous actions, Take Supplies directly, or Kill an opponent's Scavenger (which grants the victim a Candy Boost ). Drones: When playing a Drone card, you move the drone (up to 2 regions) and use its ability. Drones ignore Majority rules and level restrictions. Masamune: Harvests resources. Simon: Recruits Scavengers. Fly: Teleports Scavengers. Draco: Kills enemy Scavengers and provides VPs. Candy Boosts: These are one-time tokens that add an extra action to a played card. Additional Market Card Special actions: Gain Technology (circles) / Energy Cell (triangles) - Gain the indicated amount of resources, taking them from the reserve. Actions per Outpost (fists, black = any color of outposts, red/blue/green = that specific color of outpost) - Perform the indicated action a number of times equal to the number of corresponding controlled outposts. Advanced “Tactic” Actions (red) (Red) Tactic Move - Same as a Move Action, but you can move into a region occupied by opponents, ignoring majorities. (Red) Tactic Enlist - Same as an Enlist Action, but you can perform it in any region where you have at least one unit, no refuge required. Advanced “Logistic” Actions (blue) (Blue) Logistic Move - Same as a Move Action, but you can ignore elevation differences, no lift required. (Blue) Logistic Collect - Same effect as a Collect Action, except, if you have collected a Technology resource, you can immediately exchange it with the reserve for an Energy Cell. Advanced “Machinery” Actions (green) (Green) Machinery Enlist - Same effect as an Enlist Action, then you can also place in the region a resource from the reserve (Technology in ground regions; Energy Cell in the roof regions). (Green) Machinery Collect - Same as a Collect Action, and then you immediately gain an additional Technology from the reserve. Missions At the end of Phase 3, you must choose one mission from the display. Punctual: If the mission belongs to the current or a future round, you score the full gray section rewards. Late: If it belongs to a previous round, you score the lower blue section rewards. Restrictions: You cannot fulfill the same mission twice or pick more than one mission from the same column.
